svg.title: Figure 5-1. SPFM and LFM: status against the ASIL targets (WP-H-04 §4, §5)
svg.desc: Top: the calculation steps of §3.2 with their status from §5: configuration not frozen, FMEDA not filled (qualitative block-level FMEA only), classification and DC qualitative only, calculation cannot be done because there is no BOM, sensitivity and review not started. Bottom: for each safety-goal group of §7 (SG-01, SG-03/SG-04, SG-05, SG-02/SG-06, SG-07) the SPFM and LFM targets of §4 are marked on a 50 to 100 percent scale, and no metric is drawn because none has been computed. Hollow diamonds mark the generic-rate estimates of WP-H-03 §6.3 (FMEDA rev 0.4), which are not metrics: SG-01 SPFM 96.8 percent and LFM 88.9 percent, SG-07 SPFM 78.1 percent and LFM 97.7 percent. By decision DQ-362 the SG-01 estimate is reused for SG-02, SG-03 and SG-06 (ASIL C since HARA v0.4) and drawn on those rows too; it misses the ASIL C SPFM target by 0.16 points, an open item for G2. SG-01 carries the ASIL C targets (97 percent, 80 percent) and the ASIL B targets expected after FSC option (c) (90 percent, 60 percent); SG-02/SG-06 carry the ASIL C targets; the SG-03/SG-04 row carries C for SG-03 and B for SG-04; SG-05 and SG-07 carry the ASIL B targets. SG-05 shows its own estimate (SPFM 90.4 percent, LFM 95.3 percent), with two rows single-point for that goal. The right column repeats the engineering judgement of §5.1, which is not a metric. DC-01 is implemented but not verified and takes no DC credit.
svg.text: Figure 5-1 · SPFM and LFM against the ASIL targets: no metric yet, generic estimates shown
Status of the calculation (§5) and the applicable targets (§4) per safety goal; no metric exists; ◇ marks the generic-rate estimate of WP-H-03 §6.3 (FMEDA rev 0.4), not a metric
Missing inputs: no BOM, no schematic, no failure-rate data (§1; WP-H-02 UK-01/02)
DC-01 (IWDG1, window mode; panda 9f60e17) is implemented since 2026-10-12, not verified: no DC credit until HIL fault-injection evidence exists (§5.1). Plan steps 1–8 and their gates are in §6.
B · Targets per safety goal (§4) and computed value (§7)
likely not met; C targets not met
plausible, not certain; C unlikely w/o DC-02
C by 0.16 points, open for G2 (OI-6)
no metric · ◇ estimate with its own classification 90.4 %
for SG-01 only; siren path has no row
B unlikely without DC-03 relay readback
unless the stuck-intercepting rate is small
Targets: §4 “commonly used values — verify against licensed text” (OI-5). SG-01: C, with B alongside (DQ-063). No row may be read as met: every “Met?” cell in §7 is “Not yet computed”.

QM-SoC mechanisms and vehicle measures (EPS limit, PCM clamp) are not credited as DC (§3.3). The judgement column is §5.1 engineering judgement, stated so FSC decisions are made with eyes open; it is not a metric.
